questions.question: How do you handle flaky tests in Playwright?
questions.answer: At Northwind Payments I cut flaky tests by 70% with stable locators, test-data factories and retries with traces.
questions.tip: Expect a follow-up on root causes.

questions.question: How do you structure API tests?
questions.answer: At Contoso Retail I built RestAssured tests run in Jenkins on every build.

questions.question: A release is tomorrow and 30 tests fail. What do you do?
questions.answer: Triage by risk, check recent changes, rerun with traces, and report status clearly.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you improved a process.
questions.answer: Situation: manual regression took days at Contoso Retail. Task: speed it up. Action: automated 800 cases with Selenium. Result: 60% faster.

questions.question: Have you used Kubernetes?
questions.answer: Not in production. I have used Docker for test runners and I am learning Kubernetes basics with minikube.

questions.question: How do you mentor junior QA engineers?
questions.answer: At Northwind Payments I mentored three engineers through pairing and code reviews.
